lastCompletedAction: Correction loop 2. A second independent review found that two loop-1 fixes traded one defect for another: removing the duplicate source_events row lost the COMPANY SCOPE on every finance capture (the capture marker was recorded before the company was threaded through, and the later company-bearing call took the idempotent-replay branch), and narrowing the sweeper to exactly the finance captures meant the only wired processor dead-lettered every capture within one cron interval. It also found npm run verify RED at HEAD — the browser-check placeholder tripped the repository's own secret scanner, so the loop-1 claim that the secret scan passed was wrong and is withdrawn. Migration 0077 makes a company-less capture impossible at the table, settles a decided non-capture so the health signal stops counting it, releases rather than destroys work no processor can handle yet, requires a human routing decision to name an active member, escapes the identity delimiter, and re-asserts the capability-owner check search_path-independently. 0076 gained a fail-closed pre-check for the account-case collision it previously died on, and now stamps the canonical identity on the survivor rather than the tombstone.

openFindings: FOUND-003: no scheduled drain calls claim_inbound_dispatch_batch — a failed dispatch is recovered by provider redelivery, which is bounded by how long the provider keeps redelivering
FOUND-003: no processor exists for a captured finance event; the sweeper releases it rather than processing it, so captures accumulate as visible backlog
FOUND-003: finance classification has no model provider, so a staff finance message reaches the review queue rather than capture
FOUND-003: until a receiving number is mapped in channel_accounts, the single-tenant bridge is what attributes messages
FOUND-003: nobody can work the review queue until someone is granted operations.inbound.review
FOUND-003: non-WhatsApp ingestion paths (email, upload, bank file) have no dispatch path, so such a row would be claimable by neither lifecycle
AIM-003: a service-role caller can still assert actor_source='human' by naming a real member; the production caller hard-codes 'ai'
AIM-003: nothing proposes an assignee (WRK-002/WRK-005 unbuilt), and there is no queue UI for needs_routing work
AIM-002: the occurrence window is a UTC date and the monitor re-analyses on every inbound message, so an unresolved follow-up on an active thread is recreated once per day
AIM-002: task_duplicate_suggestions has no producer, so semantic near-duplicates are not surfaced at all
MOD-002: runQuotationTurn takes no CostLedger, so the highest-volume model call produces no ai_runs row
FOUND-006: RLS_READS/RLS_WRITES are OFF, so the app reads through the RLS-bypassing service-role client
